references.text: Moses falls on his face in a similar situation of rebellion, showing his humble reaction to the people's resistance
Moses and Aaron fall on their faces before the Lord during Korah's rebellion, the same gesture of intercession
Moses and Aaron fall on their faces when the congregation gathers against them, a parallel crisis situation
Moses and Aaron move away from the assembly and fall on their faces, the same pattern of reaction to the people's complaints
Abram falls on his face when God speaks to him, showing reverence and humility before God
Joshua falls on his face to the ground in reverence, a similar gesture of humility
Joshua falls on his face before the Lord's ark in crisis, parallel to Moses and Aaron's reaction
Ezekiel falls on his face upon encountering God's glory, the same gesture of reverence
The disciples fall on their faces in fear at the transfiguration on the mountain, a similar reaction of awe
The angels fall on their faces before the throne and worship God, the same gesture of worship and humility
